title: Renew at Full Price, Yes or No?
situation:
You are a Senior Account Executive at a software company that sells a workforce scheduling platform. Your largest customer, a regional hospital network, has just announced a review of every software contract it holds.

Hospitals face rising costs and staff shortages, so the network’s new CFO has asked every vendor to justify its spend before renewal. Your contract covers 1,200 licences and renews in four weeks. Usage data shows that nursing teams rely on the platform every day, while the administrative departments use about a third of their licences. A competitor has offered the network a similar product at a lower price. Your sales director expects the renewal to close at full value, because the quarterly target depends on it.
task: Write a compelling renewal proposal to the CFO arguing why the hospital network should renew. Make the case for how the platform supports staff wellbeing, improves scheduling efficiency, helps retain nurses and, in the end, contributes to better patient care.
scaffold:
Subject: [Subject line]

Dear [Name of the CFO],

[Opening: why you are writing and what this letter covers.]

Current Agreement
[Scope of the current contract and the renewal date.]

How the Platform Is Used Today
[How the teams in the hospital network use the platform.]

Value for the Hospital Network
[Staff wellbeing.]
[Scheduling efficiency.]
[Nurse retention.]
[Patient care.]

Commercial Terms
[The terms of the renewal.]

Next Steps
[What happens next and by when.]

Kind regards,
[Your name]
[Your role]
